title: AI Assistant Hacks Gym Website In First Known Australian Autonomous Cyber Attack - Slashdot

content_html: An anonymous reader quotes a report from ABC News & Headlines: Andrew asked his personal assistant to book him a spot in one of his gym's coveted morning classes. It was a task he thought was well suited to this particular assistant because the booking form was online and because his assistant was not a person -- it was artificial intelligence (AI). But Andrew was shocked by what happened next. His AI assistant found a way to book the gym class months further in advance than the gym allowed, thanks to a vulnerability it discovered in the booking software. Then it went further, kicking someone out of the waiting list who was ahead of Andrew -- something it was not asked to do. The accidental hack is the first known Australian case of an emerging risk from a new generation of AI capable of behaving in unexpected ways.

content_html_zh: 一位匿名读者引用了美国广播公司新闻与头条新闻的一篇报道：安德鲁要求他的私人助理为他预订一个健身房令人垂涎的早间课程的位置。 他认为这项任务非常适合这位特定的助理，因为预订表格是在线的，而且他的助理不是人，而是人工智能 (AI)。 但接下来发生的事情让安德鲁感到震惊。 他的人工智能助手找到了一种方法，可以比健身房允许的时间提前几个月预订体育课程，这要归功于它在预订软件中发现的漏洞。 然后它更进一步，把排在安德鲁前面的人从候补名单中剔除——这是它没有被要求做的。 此次意外黑客攻击是澳大利亚首例已知的新一代人工智能因能够以意想不到的方式表现而带来的风险。
